# WF12: Mechanism-control arms

<!-- generated by python -m pfp_core.workflow_families.docs: do not edit -->
**What it is for:** Run a mechanism arm against matched null and random controls on the same items.

**Status:** runnable offline. The family runner checks its fixtures with no model call and no spend. No live or local model run of this runner is recorded yet. The pilots/ folder holds data from earlier model experiments run with an older harness; they are records, not runs of this runner.

**Run it offline** (no model call, no spend), from the repository root:

```powershell
python -m pfp_core.workflow_families run WF12
python -m pytest pfp_core/workflow_families/tests/test_families.py -q -k "WF12-"
```

**The check:** `integer_rank_difference_certificate`. Only this check can certify; a model reply is evidence for it, never a verdict.

**Code:** [`pfp_core/workflow_families/layer5.py`](../../pfp_core/workflow_families/layer5.py) (`MechanismControlArms`) · [tests](../../pfp_core/workflow_families/tests/test_families.py) · [wiki page](https://github.com/dbccpage/proposal_fidelity_protocol_pfp/wiki/workflow_wf12)
<!-- end generated -->

**Kind:** experiment design. **Builds on:** [WF6](../wf06_dialect_sweep/README.md), [WF3](../wf03_mine_then_solve/README.md).

**Goal:** An arm comparison on a fixed carrier whose only difference is the mechanism note.

## How it works

1. Hold the carrier fixed; vary only the mechanism note
2. Run baseline, typed-witness and mechanism arms on the same items
3. Grade with one registered checker
4. Compare arms item by item

## The check

Host check: integer rank-difference certificate (to be registered).

- `rank difference: r_i - r_j recovered from a gauge-fixed assignment; gauge freedom r -> r + c leaves differences unchanged`
- `paired effect: d_i = 1[check(arm_B, i)] - 1[check(arm_A, i)]`

## Where it comes from

Sources: 0000052.

Ten planned capsules (c001-c010) on one integer rank-difference carrier with three distractor spans; no model was called and the checker id is not registered.

## Pilots in this folder

Model experiments for this workflow, recorded on earlier runs with an older harness. Most need a model runtime that is not published here; their recorded inputs, replies and checks are kept as data.

- [`pilots/c001_attention_distractor_mask/`](pilots/c001_attention_distractor_mask/) — masking attention to distractor keys, with a McNemar comparison of arms (needs a local model with attention hooks)
- [`pilots/c005_hosted_decode_controls/`](pilots/c005_hosted_decode_controls/) — a bake-off of hosted decoding controls (budgets, scratchpads, hybrids) on checkable cases
- [`pilots/consistency_teaching/`](pilots/consistency_teaching/) — rank-difference tasks, clean or poisoned, with direct and chain-of-thought prompts
- [`pilots/planned/`](pilots/planned/) — the C006 host scratch-space protocol (the other planned write-ups were removed)

## Team

Pattern `sweep_with_shared_judge`: coder ×1 (sonnet); deep_researcher ×1 (run_o); adversary ×1 (run_f); host_checker ×1 (none).

Boost: when leak found: rebuild the carrier; discard affected runs (limit 0).
